pages.text: An endless supply of water for reactors and the Coolant Mixer. A small pumpjack: stand it $(l)directly above a water source block$(), with its intake hanging into the water, and give it power.

$(li)Pumps $(l)500 mB/t$() with $(l)40 FE/t$() and pushes it into adjacent $(l:cables/liquid_pipe)Liquid Pipes$(/l) and machines (water is a liquid: a $(l:cables/gas_pipe)Gas Pipe$(/l) will not take it).$(br)$(li)One pump feeds 500 heat per tick: enough for a Small tower and a Medium one up to 250%. A Large tower at full power (2,000 heat) needs 4 pumps.
$(li)It has no GUI: $(l)right-click$() it to see what it is doing. While it pumps the crank turns, the beam rocks and the rod goes up and down; it runs on for a few seconds after it last pumped.
$(li)Only the block below counts: water beside it does nothing. A pump that stopped after an update, because it only had water at its sides, has to be moved over the water.

$(li)Water can't be clicked: place the pump against a temporary block beside the spot, then remove that block. Keep it above the surface, as it won't keep water out of its own block.$(br)$(li)A pipe can plug in on any side, and from below it replaces the intake.
